none: PAS CAM-6FF1FD: Roman Coin : Nummus of the House of Constantine, F[EL TEMP] REPARATIO.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ F[EL TEMP] REPARATIO ; D/ DN CONSTA[...]

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine, AD 348-350, (Reece period 18). Reverse legend reads F[EL TEMP] REPARATIO. Reverse shows Emperor left on galley, holding standard and Victory steering. Mint is uncertain. Obverse shows an unclear diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads DN CONSTA[...]. The obverse and reverse surfaces are partially obscured from study due to…
